page_title: BOL 0-0 CAG | Bologna v Cagliari 03/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Santiago Castro (Bologna) sees a yellow card from Valerio Crezzini after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+4' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
90+1' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but Elia Caprile comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) will replace Michel Adopo.
89' Nikola Moro (Bologna) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
89' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
87' Eivind Fauske Helland (Bologna) has proven his good peripheral vision as he picks out Nadir Zortea with a lovely through ball.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nadir Zortea (Bologna) comes onto the pitch so that Lorenzo De Silvestri can be given a rest.
82' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
81' Jose Pedro (Cagliari) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
80' Adam Obert (Cagliari) takes the corner.
78' Federico Bernardeschi goes off the pitch and Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) comes on.
76' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
75' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
75' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
73' The manager makes a subsitution with Paul Mendy (Cagliari) coming on for Sebastiano Esposito.
71' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
71' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Valerio Crezzini stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
68' Eivind Fauske Helland (Bologna) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
67' Santiago Castro (Bologna) drives a shot towards the bottom left corner from inside the box, but Elia Caprile leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.

66' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but his attempt went well wide of the right post.
66' Bologna have a corner.
66' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bologna.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) replaces Benjamin Dominguez.
63' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Jens Odgaard is replaced by Santiago Castro (Bologna).
62' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
61' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
60' Juan Miranda (Bologna) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
59' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) is always a threat to goalkeepers from set pieces and he will take the long-range free kick.
58' Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle for a foul after Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) hacks down one of his opponents.
56' Remo Freuler (Bologna) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Elia Caprile has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
55' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
54' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
52' Valerio Crezzini shows a yellow card to Michel Adopo (Cagliari) for a tough tackle.
51' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
48' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Cagliari.
46' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) comes on the pitch for Simon Sohm.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Cagliari can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+5' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45+3' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
45+3' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

45+2' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Corner kick. Bologna will have an opportunity.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the left post is thwarted by Massimo Pessina.
44' Wow, what an escape. Simon Sohm (Bologna) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
42' Problems for Fabio Pisacane as Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Ibrahim Sulemana replaces him.
41' Nikola Moro (Bologna) makes a strong challenge and Valerio Crezzini blows for a foul.
39' The game is interrupted now, Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
38' The linesman raises his flag. Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is adjudged offside.
36' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
35' A player from Bologna commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
35' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

34' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. Bologna will have a chance to score from a corner.
31' Juan Miranda (Bologna) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
28' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
28' Nikola Moro (Bologna) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
27' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

27' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Elia Caprile stops the ball from going inside the left post. Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
24' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
21' Bologna work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
21' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Bologna will take a corner kick.
20' Nikola Moro (Bologna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
18' Dangerous play by Jens Odgaard (Bologna). Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
14' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
12' Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle as Remo Freuler (Bologna) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
11' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
10' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nikola Moro (Bologna) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
9' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
7' Lorenzo De Silvestri is able to continue with the attacking effort as he latches on to a beautiful defence-splitting lofted pass, which was supplied by Nikola Moro (Bologna).
7' The goal by Bologna won’t count as referee Valerio Crezzini disallows the goal on the advice of the video assistant referee.
5' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Valerio Crezzini wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
3' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) has a goal ruled out for offside!
2' Valerio Crezzini couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Juan Miranda (Bologna) and blew his whistle. Cagliari have a free kick.
2' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bologna will have the kick-off.
Valerio Crezzini is the one to supervise the game today.
